title: Model-extracted campaign bible (06b-B)
description: Populate the campaign_bible row's worldFacts / majorNpcs / factions / openThreads (currently always empty) by extracting structured entries from session content via the ModelClient. Reuses the model-summarization plumbing pattern introduced by 06b-A. Parent: loreweaver-06b.
acceptance_criteria:
1. extractCampaignBible exists in @loreweaver/core and returns a structurally-validated CampaignBibleInput from SessionRecapRecord[] plus a ModelClient.
2. composeArcSummary accepts a bible: CampaignBibleInput parameter; its prompts incorporate the bible (system prompt + user message prelude).
3. CLI rollupCampaignArc runs the bible-extract -> arc-summary -> single-write pipeline in order.
4. The bible call is retried exactly once on any thrown error; on second failure, gracefulClose still completes with a warning and no arc_summary write.
5. If the bible call succeeds and the arc-summary call fails, gracefulClose still completes with a warning and no arc_summary write (atomic skip).
6. campaignBibleExtractor unit tests cover: happy path, prompt rendering, parse-failure modes (MemorySummaryError on missing fence / non-JSON / wrong shape), ModelClientError propagation.
7. CLI play.test.ts covers four scenarios: happy path, bible retry-success, bible-fails-twice, summary-fails-after-bible.
8. npm run typecheck and npm run test (vitest run) both succeed.
